terminology_highlights: Co-Packer — A third-party contract manufacturer used to blend, fill, or package specific home and personal care SKUs to manage capacity surges.
PCR Packaging — Post-Consumer Recycled plastic used in bottles for brands like Dove and Omo to meet Unilever's sustainability commitments.
Wash-Off / Leave-On — Categorization of personal care products (e.g., body wash vs. skin lotion) which dictates specific formulation and quality compliance standards.
Trade Promotions — Strategic discounts and marketing funds allocated to retail partners to drive volume and secure premium shelf space.
